job.title: Data Analyst (sql)
job.description:
We are seeking a highly motivated Data Analyst to join a Global Customer Success Data Science Team, based in London, UK, focusing on building core data capabilities across multiple global regions and markets. This role is critical in addressing analytics gaps by enabling actionable insights, automating dashboards, and ensuring consistent, reliable data foundations.

This is a team that is actively building AI-native analytics capabilities — not experimenting with AI in the margins, but embedding it into core workflows. You'll be expected to bring genuine enthusiasm for AI, apply it in your day-to-day work, and contribute to an AI-focused workstream that is automating insights, reducing manual reporting, and advancing predictive capabilities across international markets.


Key Responsibilities
• Building robust data foundations: Collaborate with engineering to develop pipelines, improve data integrity, and establish clear metric definitions and governance tailored for International markets. Build data capabilities that work consistently across multiple regions and countries, while tailoring requirements to specific local needs (e.g., regulatory, language, or workflow differences). Automate recurring reporting and validation processes to increase accuracy and efficiency. Ensure data structures and taxonomies are built for downstream AI consumption and model-readiness.
• Developing actionable dashboards & reporting: Create and maintain scalable, user-friendly dashboards that provide visibility into key performance metrics. Think broadly across the end-to-end customer journey — designing reporting that connects metrics across touchpoints rather than optimizing in silos — so that International teams have timely, market-relevant insights to make data-informed decisions.

Skills
________________________________________
• experience in Data Analytics , ideally with exposure to Customer Success, Operations, or Digital Experience domains
• Proficiency in SQL for data extraction, transformation, and pipeline development
• Experience with dashboarding and visualization tools (Tableau, Qlik, or similar)
• Familiarity with big data tools (Snowflake, Databricks, Spark) and ETL processes
• Experience with Python or R for advanced analytics, automation, or experimentation support preferred
• Knowledge of statistical methods and experimentation (A/B testing) preferred
• Machine learning and Generative AI experience is a plus

job.title: Automation Engineer
job.description:
IT Specialist - Application Upgrades & Automation Engineer


Location: Hybrid (50% onsite)
Contract Length: 6 Months
Rate: Up to £400-£450 per day Umbrella (depending on experience)
Security Clearance: SC Clearance

Overview


We are seeking an experienced IT Specialist to support a major programme of application upgrades, migrations, and future platform modernisation initiatives within a large and complex enterprise environment.
This role will focus on delivering application and infrastructure upgrade activities across both Windows and Linux platforms, while driving automation and engineering best practices. The successful candidate will play a key role in ensuring applications remain secure, vendor-supported, and aligned with operational standards.
Working closely with application, infrastructure, and engineering teams, you will be responsible for planning and executing upgrades, troubleshooting issues, implementing automation solutions, and contributing to the organisation's wider technology objectives.
Strong communication skills are essential, as the role requires regular collaboration with technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Key Responsibilities

  • Plan, coordinate and deliver application upgrades, migrations, and platform refresh activities.
  • Ensure applications remain compliant with vendor support lifecycles and security requirements.
  • Administer and support enterprise applications across Windows and Linux environments.
  • Troubleshoot application, middleware, database, and infrastructure-related issues.
  • Perform root cause analysis and implement long-term solutions to recurring problems.
  • Develop and maintain operational documentation, procedures, and support runbooks.
  • Identify opportunities to automate manual operational processes and improve efficiency.
  • Build and maintain automation solutions using PowerShell, Bash, Python, Ansible, or similar technologies.
  • Design, develop, and support CI/CD deployment pipelines.
  • Promote Infrastructure as Code (IaC) and DevOps best practices across the technology estate.
  • Support application release management and deployment activities.
  • Collaborate with engineering, infrastructure, and operational teams to ensure successful delivery of upgrades and enhancements.
  • Provide documentation, knowledge transfer, and technical guidance where required.

Essential Skills & Experience

  • Strong experience administering enterprise applications across both Windows and Linux environments.
  • Proven experience delivering application and platform upgrades within production environments.
  • Hands-on experience with scripting and automation using PowerShell, Bash, Python, or similar technologies.
  • Experience with configuration management tools such as Ansible.
  • Strong understanding of application servers, middleware technologies, and databases.
  • Excellent troubleshooting, diagnostic, and root cause analysis skills.
  • Experience working within large-scale enterprise organisations.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and work effectively within structured change and release processes.
  • Strong stakeholder management and communication skills.

Desirable Skills & Experience

  • Experience integrating Artifactory, Xray, and SonarQube into CI/CD pipelines.
  • Knowledge of application release management, dependency management, and repository governance.
  • Experience designing, implementing, and maintaining GitHub Actions CI/CD pipelines.
  • Experience with monitoring, logging, and observability tooling.
  • Exposure to Infrastructure as Code and modern DevOps delivery practices.
  • Previous experience working within highly regulated environments.
  • Active SC Clearance or eligibility to obtain clearance.

What's on Offer

  • Opportunity to work on a large-scale application modernisation and upgrade programme.
  • Exposure to complex enterprise environments spanning Windows and Linux technologies.
  • Work with modern automation, DevOps, and CI/CD tooling.
  • Competitive day rate of up to £450 per day Umbrella.
  • Initial 6-month contract with potential for extension.
  • Hybrid working model with 50% onsite presence required.

job.title: IAM Architect
job.description:
IDENTITY ARCHITECT – SECURE ENTERPRISE IAM

Job Title: Identity Architect / Lead IAM Architect

Location: Wiltshire (Hybrid – 2 days/week onsite)

Job Type: Permanent

Clearance Required: Active SC Clearance (Mandatory)

Salary: Competitive + Benefits (DOE)

Start Date: Immediate

Job Summary

We are seeking an experienced Identity Architect with active SC clearance to take complete architectural ownership of a large-scale, enterprise Identity and Access Management (IAM) service supporting a highly secure public sector program.

This role requires a balanced senior architect who can drive high-level strategic direction while remaining comfortable working hands-on with identity schemas, APIs, workflow engine logic, data feeds, and live service support teams.

Key Accountabilities & Role Overview

  • Architecture Leadership: Lead end-to-end IAM architecture across development, data, and live service operations; act as the lead technical authority across delivery teams, third-party suppliers, and senior stakeholders.
  • Core IAM Capability Ownership: Drive strategic oversight of Joiner/Mover/Leaver (JML) processes, identity lifecycle management, role governance, access recertification, and regulatory audit compliance.
  • Technical & Schema Design: Shape and review detailed designs covering identity schemas, LDAP directories, data attribute models, provisioning workflows, microservices, and API integrations.
  • Platform Modernisation & Debt Reduction: Simplify legacy architecture patterns, eliminate unnecessary customisations, champion API-led integration models, and support roadmap alignment with cloud-native / Microsoft Entra environments.
  • Service Supportability & Operations: Collaborate directly with L2/L3 support and DevOps teams to author runbooks, perform root-cause analysis on complex defects, and ensure seamless BAU service transition.

Mandatory Criteria & Technical Requirements

  • Security Clearance: Active UK SC Clearance is mandatory prior to starting.
  • Architecture Track Record: Proven experience as a Lead, Senior, or Principal Architect owning enterprise-wide IAM solutions.
  • Domain Expertise: Deep knowledge of identity governance, authentication/authorization protocols, directory services, and enterprise integration patterns within government, defence, or regulated environments.
  • Hands-on Technical Capability: Practical expertise with identity schema design, API interfaces, microservices, workflow logic, and data transformation/ETL pipelines.
  • Location: Ability to work onsite in Corsham at least 2 days per week.

Desirable Experience

  • IAM Platforms: OpenText/NetIQ, SailPoint, Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD), Okta, ForgeRock, or CyberArk.
  • Cloud & Federation: AWS cloud environments, M365 identity integration, SAML/OIDC, and API Gateways.
  • Frameworks: Secure-by-Design principles, containerised deployments, and automated deployment pipelines.

How to Apply

If you meet the mandatory SC clearance requirement and possess a strong technical background in enterprise identity architecture, please submit your CV for immediate consideration.

job.description:
Payments Consultant (Bacs, Faster Payments & CHAPS)

Remote (UK) | Contract | Financial Services | Initial 6-Month Engagement

Payments Consultant | UK Domestic Payments

We are supporting a major financial services programme and are seeking experienced Payments Consultants with specialist expertise in Bacs, Faster Payments (FPS) and/or CHAPS.

This is a specialist advisory role focused on UK domestic payment schemes, operational processes and implementation considerations. The successful candidate will work closely with Business Analysts, Product Teams, Architects and programme stakeholders, providing expert guidance on how payment schemes operate and what organisations must consider when delivering payment capabilities through a sponsor bank model.

This is not a project management, transformation or delivery leadership role. We are specifically looking for payments professionals with deep scheme knowledge who can advise on operational mechanics, participant obligations and industry best practice.

Key Responsibilities

  • Provide subject matter expertise across Bacs, Faster Payments and/or CHAPS.
  • Advise stakeholders on scheme mechanics, operating models and implementation considerations.
  • Support discovery, requirements gathering and solution design activities.
  • Provide guidance on sponsor bank and indirect participation models.
  • Review payment solutions and ensure alignment with scheme requirements and industry standards.
  • Support Business Analysts, Product Owners, Architects and technical teams throughout delivery.
  • Explain payment flows, message processing, operational controls and participant responsibilities.
  • Identify risks, dependencies and operational considerations relating to UK domestic payments.
  • Deliver knowledge transfer and specialist guidance to programme stakeholders.

Experience Required

  • Demonstrable expertise in one or more of:
    • Bacs
    • Faster Payments (FPS)
    • CHAPS
  • Experience operating, implementing or supporting UK payment scheme capabilities.
  • Strong understanding of payment processing, scheme rules and settlement processes.
  • Experience advising stakeholders on payments-related business and technology initiatives.
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.

Suitable Backgrounds

We are particularly interested in candidates who have worked as:

  • Payments Consultant
  • Senior Payments Consultant
  • Payments SME
  • Payments Product Owner
  • Payments Product Manager
  • Scheme Manager
  • Scheme Product Owner
  • Payments Operations Manager
  • Payments Solution Consultant
  • Payments Implementation Consultant
  • Payments Architect with hands-on scheme experience

Desirable Experience

  • Sponsor bank and indirect participation models.
  • Banking and financial services organisations.
  • Payment platform implementations.
  • Experience with organisations such as Form3, Vocalink, Finastra, ACI Worldwide, Volante, Bottomline, Temenos, ClearBank, Banking Circle or Modulr.
  • Consulting experience within large-scale payments programmes.

Contract Details

  • Role: Payments Consultant
  • Contract Length: Initial 6 months
  • Location: Remote (UK)
  • Engagement Type: Contract
  • Rate: Flexible for the right specialist
  • Extension Potential: Strong
  • Start Date: ASAP

Apply

If you have deep expertise in Bacs, Faster Payments or CHAPS and can demonstrate hands-on experience supporting the implementation, operation or optimisation of UK domestic payment capabilities, we would be keen to hear from you. Apply with your latest CV for immediate consideration.
